fixtures.preview: A winless-in-eight United, 16th on 7 points, visit fifth-placed Chelsea with Michael Carrick still in charge (11:30pm Sat 31 Oct Sydney).
talking_points: United have 7 points from 8 league games, their worst Premier League start, and are winless in eight in all competitions.
Bruno Fernandes, benched against Bournemouth in what Carrick called a tactical call, is likely to return; Kobbie Mainoo is back in training.
Marcus Rashford faces a fitness test; Sesko (out until the new year), Shaw, Dorgu and Ugarte are out, so Dalot is expected at left-back.
Chelsea get Cole Palmer back from suspension but are reported without Joao Pedro (thigh) and Emiliano Martinez (jaw surgery).

fixtures.preview: Matchday 4 of the Champions League league phase brings Roma to Old Trafford (7am Wed 4 Nov Sydney).
A Sunday 4:30pm UK home game against Villa, who beat Manchester City 2-1 on Saturday.
The trip to Anfield is set for Sunday 22 November at 4:30pm UK time.
Matchday 5 in Lisbon, listed by UEFA at 21:00 CET (7am Thu 26 Nov Sydney).
Unbeaten Sydney visit a winless Melbourne City for their Halloween home opener (5pm Sat 31 Oct Melbourne time).
talking_points: Sydney are unbeaten after two rounds, including a 2-1 win over Adelaide; City have not won yet after a 1-1 draw with Victory.
Per a match preview, Sydney are without Gus Hoefsloot, Jacob Farrell, Abel Walatee and Jake Hollman, all still sidelined.
City are reported missing Mazzeo, Caputo, Lopane, Kalms and Rossetto, but new signings Marcondes and Cascante may push for starts.
Patrick Kisnorbo, a former City coach, returns to AAMI Park; City lead the all-time head-to-head 19-17.
